findings.evidence: User Experience / Architecture — bar "focused and ready" at load yet bare keys (j/k, x, 1/2/3, ?) are the triage fast path
findings.suggestion: Define explicit focus handoff (e.g. Down/Esc from empty bar moves focus to list; any printable char refocuses bar) before spec

findings.evidence: Data Model — Recurrence lacks day-of-month anchor; monthly clamping and advance-from-today rules conflict via implicit dueDate anchor
findings.suggestion: Add anchor field (byMonthDay) and state that spawned occurrences carry recurrence forward

findings.evidence: UX Feedback & undo — Cmd-Z advertised while focus lives in a text input with native undo; redo and undo-of-undo unspecified
findings.suggestion: Spec must define Cmd-Z routing per focus context and redo behavior

findings.evidence: Overview/Testing — "capture <2s" and "triage <1min" are human-time metrics no gate can assert
findings.suggestion: Define machine proxies (keystrokes-to-capture, Enter-to-render latency budget) as acceptance criteria

findings.evidence: Edge Cases — parser grammar shown by example only; "12 jun", "15:00", "in 3 days", "every weekday", multiple tags, !p4 undefined
findings.suggestion: PRD must enumerate a definitive supported-token table (no chrono-node available)

findings.evidence: Architecture/Testing — zero-axe and Lighthouse a11y 1.0 gates but no aria-live, focus-management, or roving-tabindex design
findings.suggestion: Add an a11y design pass (toast announcements, chip SR text, overlay focus traps, list semantics) at spec time

findings.evidence: Structure — no story enumeration or wave sketch
findings.suggestion: Spec should sequence parser/store/selectors before UI stories

findings.evidence: UX Views — Today includes all anytime tasks, blurring Today vs All; Done ordering unspecified
findings.suggestion: Define explicit anytime-in-Today rule and Done sort order

findings.evidence: UX/Edge Cases — snoozing an undated task silently converts it to scheduled
findings.suggestion: Define snooze behavior for dueDate:null tasks

findings.evidence: Data Model — order field has no reorder interaction designed
findings.suggestion: Add reorder UX or drop the field

findings.evidence: UX/Edge Cases — Esc means chip-revert, command-mode exit, cheatsheet close, edit cancel with no precedence
findings.suggestion: Define Esc precedence within the bar context

findings.evidence: Edge Cases Storage — external storage reload leaves undo stack pointing at stale state
findings.suggestion: State that undo stack clears on external reload

findings.evidence: Edge Cases Time — "DST can't break anything" overclaims; midnight timer and next-week math are DST-sensitive
findings.suggestion: Require DST-transition unit tests instead of asserting immunity

findings.evidence: Testing — 80% global coverage with untested React shell may not close
findings.suggestion: Plan component tests or scope coverage to src/lib

findings.evidence: Overview/Data Model — lists vs projects boundary and data export not pinned in Non-Goals
findings.suggestion: PRD Non-Goals: lists are flat labels only; declare export in or out
